official_eqr_sudoku.environment_note: Official FlashAttention path is blocked on this glibc2.31/CUDA11.7-nvcc host; PyTorch SDPA fallback was used and reproduced the Sudoku quick gate, but slowly.
official_eqr_sudoku.full_eval_note: Official full paper-scale Sudoku eval uses 8 GPUs, 423168 examples, and about 33.6 hours per the EqR README; this GPU1-only run is the official quick gate, not full paper-scale.

official_mixer_e1024.decision: Discard simply training this mixer replacement longer. FutureSeed wins the early matched gates, but by e1024 the official mixer-base reaches nonzero exact and much better accuracy/loss. The lower FutureSeed residual8/16 now indicates a stable wrong attractor, not better reasoning.

official_native_rwkv_gate.reason: native FutureSeed state seeding is integrated and trainable, but matched D192/L2/E64 gate is essentially tied with no-FS and slower at eval; exact remains zero for both.
